Recently, I have come to the conclusion to permanently delete and stop using all social media websites (Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, snapchat). Here are some reasons to elaborate on my decision: 1) Facebook, Twitter and snapchat have shown they cannot be trusted. Recent reports about snapchat storing every photo taken with the app, Facebook censoring various posts they don't agree with, and Twitter snooping in people's direct messages are just a few of many examples. 2) These websites ask for to much personal information from you I don't feel comfortable with giving out. For example: locations, phone numbers, birthdays, etc. 3) Most people, not everyone, on social media feel the need to share things which I couldn't give two shits about, or they are just simply unintelligent.

Some of my friends have asked my why I quit using social media, I explained this to them with the same reasons I listed above, Which I feel are valid and rational reasons. A few responses I got were "if you don't don't use social media then you have something to hide" or "your not in touch with today's society, it's like your living in the Stone Age". A few people even went as far as to say that these websites care about your privacy, and that reports of them spying on you were false. HA!

Anyways, i wanted hear what other people thought about my decision or if anyone did anything similar.
